name.ja: BB戦士 307夏侯惇(カコウトン)ギロス

brands.ja: SD ガンダム BB戦士

description.ja: 曹操が最も信頼する鋼の猛将“夏侯惇ギロス”がBB戦士にラインナップ 武器の中に鎖が通っており、必殺技を再現可能 鎧の着脱により軽装形態を再現、鎧は他の三国伝キャラと交換可能 握り拳以外に、表情の付いた平手（左手）が付属
description.en: Cao Cao's most trusted steel general "Xiahou Dungyros" is now available as a BB warrior. There is a chain running through the weapon, allowing him to perform his special moves. By attaching and detaching the armor, he can recreate his light armored form, and the armor can be replaced with other Sangokuden characters. In addition to his clenched fist, he also comes with a flat hand (left hand) with an expression on it.
